### Observed differences

- The order between the pair of activities A21/A22 and the block A30, A31, A36, A37, A38 reversed. In the earlier window, A21 preceded each block activity in 100% of the 200 traces, and A22 did so in 100% as well; in the later window, each block activity preceded A21 in about 99.5 in 100 traces (199 of 200) and preceded A22 in the same share, while every one of these pairs still co-occurred in all traces in both windows. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010]
- The block's entry and exit were rewired. Earlier, A20's observed outgoing transitions went to A22 in about 100 in 100 cases; in the later window, A20 led to each of the five block activities in roughly 16–23 in 100 transitions and to A22 in only about 0.5 in 100. Earlier, A21's transitions spread over the five block activities (about 16–23 in 100 each); in the later window, A21 led to A25 in about 99.5 in 100 transitions. [DIR001, DIR002]
- The block's own exit changed. Earlier, each of A30, A31, A36, A37 and A38 led to A25 in roughly 18–25 in 100 of its observed transitions and never to A22; in the later window, A25 fell to about 0 in 100 and A22 appeared at about 17–22 in 100, while transitions among the five themselves stayed broadly similar. [DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007]
- Event positions shifted accordingly: A22's mean position moved from about 0.39 to about 0.52 of the trace and A21's from about 0.52 to about 0.65, while the five block activities moved from about 0.60 to about 0.44 — shifts of roughly 0.13–0.17 (event ranks, not clock times). [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007]
- Step gaps agree: earlier, the distance from A21 to each block activity spread over 1–5 steps; in the later window, the ordered pairs A21→block activity and block activity→A25 each occurred within five steps in only about 1 of 200 traces, though each later-window gap profile rests on a single trace. [LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the five-activity block A30, A31, A36, A37, A38 and the A22–A21 segment exchanged their order: in the earlier window a case typically ran A20 → A22 → A21 → the block (in varying internal order) → A25, whereas in the later window it typically runs A20 → the block → A22 → A21 → A25. Screening produced 34 qualifying items from 110 tested units against roughly 0.55 expected for an unchanged process, all in the control-flow family, so the volume of signals is far beyond what random re-splits of a stable process produce. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010]

The hypothesis is shown directly and consistently: all ten relational items flip from a 100% fixed order to the opposite fixed order while co-occurrence stays complete in both windows, which rules out a rare variant appearing in one window or a shift between alternatives and joint execution; the routing changes at the block's entry (A20 into the block) and exits (block to A22 instead of A25; A21 to A25) match the same re-wiring; and all seven position shifts point in the same direction. Every DIR, POS and REL item is backed by all 200 traces in each window. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007]

Limitations: the link between A22 and A21 itself is not directly observed — A22's outgoing transitions were not profiled, so A22 preceding A21 rests on event positions — and the later-window LAG profiles rest on about one trace each. A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that further activities sit between A22 and A21 in one or both windows, or that the rare A20→A22 transition (about 0.5 in 100) is a retained alternative path rather than noise. [POS001, POS002, DIR001, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010]
